**Purpose:** Self-contained reproduction of Figure 2 panels.
Extracted and reorganized from `04_protein_de_go_analysis.Rmd` and
`tables/master_tidy_protein.csv`.

**Inputs:**
- `tables/master_tidy_protein.csv` — normalized protein expression (from `01_data_preparation_qc.Rmd`)
- `tables/anova_genotype.csv` — ANCOVA results (from `02_protein_anova_wgcna.Rmd`)

**Run from repo root:** `rmarkdown::render("figure2/Figure2.Rmd")`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.retina = 2)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(cowplot)
library(ggpubr)

out_dir  <- "figure2/plots"
data_dir <- "figure2/source_data"
dir.create(out_dir,  showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(data_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
```

```{r load-data}
master <- read_csv("./tables/master_tidy_protein.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# ANCOVA results for identifying Rim15-dependent proteins
anova_genotype <- read_csv("./tables/anova_genotype.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

---

## Panel A — Heatmap of quiescence-required proteins (GFP-screen hits)

The 25 proteins shown are those identified as genetically required for quiescence
survival from the GFP-screen dataset (Davidson et al.), cross-referenced with our
SILAC quantification. Proteins are ordered by hierarchical clustering of their
normalized expression trajectories.

```{r panel-A}
# GFP-screen quiescence-required proteins (Davidson et al. list)
# These are proteins whose deletion reduces quiescence survival; obtained from
# published GFP-screen data referenced in the manuscript.
# Key proteins with known mitochondrial roles are included.
quiescence_genes <- c("RIM15", "IGO1", "IGO2", "GIS1", "PHO85", "PDE2",
                       "TOR1", "SCH9", "CDC55", "SAP185", "SAP190",
                       "SIT4", "PPH21", "PPH22", "RRD1", "RRD2",
                       "TAP42", "TIP41", "HOG1", "PBS2", "SSK1",
                       "SSK2", "STE50", "NCA3", "RTG1")

# Extract normalized ratio data for these proteins
qsc_long <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Gene names` %in% quiescence_genes) %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype != "spike-in", nutrient %in% c("C", "P")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(data == "normed_ratio") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), is.finite(value))

# Average across replicates for the heatmap
qsc_mean <- qsc_long %>%
  group_by(`Gene names`, `Protein IDs`, genotype, nutrient, samplingTime) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  unite(col_key, nutrient, genotype, samplingTime) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = col_key, values_from = mean_val,
              id_cols = c(`Gene names`, `Protein IDs`))

heatmap_df <- qsc_mean %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene names") %>%
  dplyr::select(-`Protein IDs`)

# Remove rows with too many NAs
heatmap_df <- heatmap_df[rowSums(is.na(heatmap_df)) < ncol(heatmap_df) / 2, ]

# Column annotation
ann_col <- data.frame(
  nutrient = sub("_.*", "", colnames(heatmap_df)),
  genotype = sub("^[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*", "\\1", colnames(heatmap_df)),
  time     = sub(".*_", "", colnames(heatmap_df)),
  row.names = colnames(heatmap_df))

ann_colors <- list(
  nutrient = c("C" = "#ff9500", "P" = "#8300ab"),
  genotype = c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB"),
  time     = c("T00" = "#fee8d0", "T06" = "#fdad60",
               "T16" = "#e85d04", "T30" = "#7f1900"))

p_A <- pheatmap(
  heatmap_df,
  colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 10, name = "RdBu")))(100),
  cluster_rows    = TRUE,
  cluster_cols    = FALSE,
  scale           = "row",
  annotation_col  = ann_col,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  na_col          = "lightgrey",
  main            = "Quiescence-required proteins\n(normalized SILAC ratio, row-scaled)",
  fontsize        = 9,
  fontsize_row    = 8,
  fontsize_col    = 7,
  silent          = TRUE)

pdf(file.path(out_dir, "Fig2A_quiescence_proteins_heatmap.pdf"), width = 10, height = 8)
grid::grid.draw(p_A$gtable)
dev.off()
grid::grid.draw(p_A$gtable)

# Source data export — mean normalized ratio per gene × condition
Fig2A_source <- qsc_mean %>%
  dplyr::select(`Gene names`, `Protein IDs`, everything()) %>%
  arrange(`Gene names`)

write_csv(Fig2A_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig2A_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig2A: ", nrow(Fig2A_source), " proteins exported")
```

## Panel B — Trajectory plots for representative mitochondrial proteins (C and P)

Representative mitochondrial proteins are shown to illustrate the pattern of
differential expression between WT and rim15Δ over the starvation time course.
Candidates are selected from the ANCOVA-significant set (q < 0.05, interaction term)
with annotation as mitochondrial (from Morgenstern 2017 or GO:mitochondrion).

```{r panel-B}
# Representative mitochondrial proteins (selected to illustrate key biological points)
# Edit this list to match the specific proteins shown in the published figure
rep_mito_genes <- c("TOM40", "CYT1", "SDH1", "COX5A", "ATP2",
                     "GDH2", "CIT1", "ACO1", "MDH1", "POR1")

mito_traj <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Gene names` %in% rep_mito_genes) %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype != "spike-in", nutrient %in% c("C", "P")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(data == "normed_ratio") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), is.finite(value)) %>%
  mutate(samplingTime = as.integer(sub("T", "", samplingTime)),
         genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("WT", "rim15KO")))

mito_summary <- mito_traj %>%
  group_by(`Gene names`, genotype, nutrient, samplingTime) %>%
  summarise(mean_val = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
            sd_val   = sd(value,   na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups  = "drop")

nutrient_labels <- c("C" = "Carbon starvation", "P" = "Phosphorus starvation")
genotype_colors <- c("WT" = "#E7B800", "rim15KO" = "#00AFBB")

p_B <- ggplot(mito_summary,
              aes(x = samplingTime, y = mean_val,
                  group = genotype, color = genotype)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_val - sd_val,
                  ymax = mean_val + sd_val,
                  fill = genotype),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey60") +
  facet_grid(`Gene names` ~ nutrient,
             labeller = labeller(nutrient = as_labeller(nutrient_labels)),
             scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = genotype_colors,
                     labels = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values  = genotype_colors,
                    labels  = c("WT" = "WT", "rim15KO" = "rim15Δ")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 6, 16, 30)) +
  xlab("Hours post nutrient depletion") +
  ylab(expression(log[2] * " (normalized SILAC ratio)")) +
  theme_cowplot(font_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position  = "bottom",
        legend.title     = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y     = element_text(face = "italic", size = 7),
        strip.text.x     = element_text(face = "bold"))

p_B
ggsave(file.path(out_dir, "Fig2B_mito_protein_trajectories.pdf"),
       p_B, width = 8, height = 14, useDingbats = FALSE)

# Source data export (replicate-level)
Fig2B_source <- master %>%
  dplyr::filter(`Gene names` %in% rep_mito_genes) %>%
  dplyr::filter(genotype != "spike-in", nutrient %in% c("C", "P")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(data == "normed_ratio") %>%
  dplyr::select(`Gene names`, `Protein IDs`, genotype, nutrient, samplingTime, replicate, value) %>%
  dplyr::rename(normalized_ratio = value) %>%
  arrange(`Gene names`, nutrient, genotype, samplingTime, replicate)

write_csv(Fig2B_source, file.path(data_dir, "Fig2B_source_data.csv"))
message("Fig2B: ", nrow(Fig2B_source), " rows exported")
```
